ruleDefinitions.name: Dllhost.EXE Execution Anomaly
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a "dllhost" process spawning with no commandline arguments which is very rare to happen and could indicate process injection activity or malware mimicking similar system processes.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = "dllhost\.exe" OR process_command_line = "dllhost")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = "None")
